title.en: SiliconFlow API Key Complete Guide (2026): Setup, Free Models, Pricing & BYOK
title.zh: 硅基流动（SiliconFlow）API Key 完全指南（2026）：开通、免费模型、定价与 BYOK

excerpt.en: Everything about SiliconFlow API keys: register on siliconflow.cn, get free models like Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-R1, understand pricing tiers, call 200+ open-source models via one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and set up BYOK in your favorite AI tools.
excerpt.zh: 关于硅基流动 API Key 的一切：在 siliconflow.cn 注册、获取 Qwen3-8B 和 DeepSeek-R1 等免费模型、理解定价分级、通过一个 OpenAI 兼容端点调用 200+ 开源模型，以及在你常用的 AI 工具中配置 BYOK。

en: SiliconFlow (硅基流动) is China's largest open-source model inference aggregation platform. Instead of signing up for separate accounts at DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, and MiniMax, you register once on SiliconFlow and access 200+ open-source models through a single API key and a unified OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

The platform handles model hosting, load balancing, and inference optimization, so you don't need to deploy models on your own GPUs. This makes SiliconFlow especially popular among Chinese developers and anyone who wants to experiment with multiple open-source models without managing infrastructure.

SiliconFlow offers a generous free tier: several production-grade models — including Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and DeepSeek-OCR — can be called for free within rate limits, making it one of the best-value API platforms in 2026.
zh: 硅基流动（SiliconFlow）是中国最大的开源模型推理聚合平台。你不需要在 DeepSeek、通义千问、智谱、MiniMax 各开一个账号，只需在硅基流动注册一次，就能通过一个 API Key 和统一的 OpenAI 兼容端点调用 200+ 开源模型。
平台负责模型托管、负载均衡和推理优化，你不需要自己部署 GPU。这让硅基流动在中国开发者以及想快速试多个开源模型的人群中特别受欢迎。
硅基流动提供慷慨的免费额度：多个生产级模型——包括 Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 和 DeepSeek-OCR——在速率限制内可免费调用，是 2026 年性价比最高的 API 平台之一。

heading.en: Available Models: 200+ Open-Source Models in One Place
heading.zh: 可用模型：200+ 开源模型一站调用

en: SiliconFlow aggregates models from dozens of leading open-source providers. The catalog includes the DeepSeek family (DeepSeek V4-Pro, DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models), Alibaba's Qwen3 series, Zhipu's GLM-5, Moonshot's Kimi K2.6, and MiniMax-M2.5. Each model is identified by a namespaced ID like deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro or Qwen/Qwen3-8B.

A standout feature is the free model tier. Qwen3-8B is ideal for general conversation and light tasks, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B provides chain-of-thought reasoning at no cost, and DeepSeek-OCR handles document and image text extraction for free. These are not toy models — they are production-capable and only limited by rate limits.

For a detailed breakdown of every model on the platform including benchmarks, use-case recommendations, and the full pricing table, see our comprehensive [[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|SiliconFlow models and pricing guide]].
zh: 硅基流动聚合了数十家领先开源厂商的模型。目录包括 DeepSeek 家族（DeepSeek V4-Pro、DeepSeek-R1 推理模型）、阿里的 Qwen3 系列、智谱的 GLM-5、月之暗面的 Kimi K2.6 以及 MiniMax-M2.5。每个模型用命名空间 ID 标识，如 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro 或 Qwen/Qwen3-8B。
一大亮点是免费模型层。Qwen3-8B 适合通用对话和轻量任务，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 免费提供思维链推理，DeepSeek-OCR 免费做文档和图片文字提取。这些不是玩具模型——它们具备生产能力，仅受速率限制。
如需平台全部模型的详细说明，包括基准测试、使用场景推荐和完整定价表，请参阅我们的 [[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|硅基流动模型与定价指南]]。

heading.en: How to Get a SiliconFlow API Key
heading.zh: 如何获取硅基流动 API Key

en: Registering and obtaining an API key takes about five minutes. Visit siliconflow.cn, sign up with a phone number (Chinese +86 numbers are standard; international users can use the global site at siliconflow.com), complete real-name verification to unlock bonus credits, then navigate to the API Keys page in the console to create your key.

New users receive ¥14 in credits upon registration and an additional ¥16 after real-name verification, totaling ¥30 of free credit — enough for extensive experimentation with both free and paid models.

For the complete step-by-step walkthrough including screenshots of every page, the real-name verification process, and how to claim bonus credits, follow our [[guide:how-to-get-silicon-flow-api-key|SiliconFlow API key registration tutorial]].
zh: 注册并获取 API Key 大约需要五分钟。访问 siliconflow.cn，用手机号注册（中国 +86 号码是标准流程，国际用户可访问全球站 siliconflow.com），完成实名认证解锁赠送额度，然后在控制台「API 密钥」页面创建 Key。
新用户注册即赠 ¥14 额度，实名认证后再赠 ¥16，共 ¥30 免费额度——足够你对免费和付费模型做大量实验。
如需包含每个页面截图、实名认证流程和如何领取赠送额度的完整步骤教程，请参阅我们的 [[guide:how-to-get-silicon-flow-api-key|硅基流动 API Key 注册教程]]。

en: SiliconFlow uses a prepaid credits model with a six-tier rate-limit system. Your tier is determined by your cumulative spending: L0 (under ¥50) has the lowest limits, while L5 (¥10,000+) unlocks the highest throughput. Moving up tiers is automatic — spend more, get higher limits.

Paid model pricing is competitive. DeepSeek-V4-Pro costs about ¥4 per million input tokens and ¥16 per million output tokens. Qwen3-235B is similarly priced. The free models remain free regardless of your tier, with rate limits scaling up as you climb tiers.
The [[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|complete pricing breakdown]] compares every model side by side so you can choose the most cost-effective option for your workload.
zh: 硅基流动采用预付额度模式，配套六级速率限制体系。你的等级由累计消费决定：L0（¥50 以下）限制最低，L5（¥10,000 以上）吞吐量最高。升级是自动的——消费越多，限制越高。
付费模型定价有竞争力。DeepSeek-V4-Pro 约 ¥4/百万输入 Tokens、¥16/百万输出 Tokens。Qwen3-235B 价格相近。免费模型无论你处于哪个等级都保持免费，速率限制随等级提升而放宽。
[[guide:silicon-flow-models-and-pricing|完整定价对照表]]并排比较了每个模型，帮你为不同负载选择最具性价比的方案。

en: Free models: Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, DeepSeek-OCR (rate-limited)
Paid flagship: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (~¥4 input / ¥16 output per million tokens)
Six rate-limit tiers: L0 (<¥50 spend) to L5 (≥¥10,000 spend)
New user bonus: ¥14 registration + ¥16 real-name verification = ¥30 total
Prepaid credits model — top up as needed, no monthly subscription required
zh: 免费模型：Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、DeepSeek-OCR（有速率限制）
付费旗舰：DeepSeek-V4-Pro（约 ¥4 输入 / ¥16 输出，每百万 Tokens）
六级速率限制：L0（消费 <¥50）到 L5（消费 ≥¥10,000）
新用户福利：注册 ¥14 + 实名认证 ¥16 = 共 ¥30
预付额度模式——按需充值，无需月度订阅

heading.en: Quick Start: Your First SiliconFlow API Call
heading.zh: 快速开始：第一次硅基流动 API 调用

en: SiliconFlow is fully OpenAI-compatible. Use the standard OpenAI SDK with the SiliconFlow base URL and your API key. The model ID format is vendor/model-name.
zh: 硅基流动完全兼容 OpenAI 格式。使用标准 OpenAI SDK，配合硅基流动的 base URL 和你的 API Key。模型 ID 格式为「厂商/模型名」。

heading.en: Using SiliconFlow in AI Tools (BYOK Mode)
heading.zh: 在 AI 工具中使用硅基流动（BYOK 模式）

en: One of SiliconFlow's biggest advantages is Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) compatibility. Because the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, you can paste your SiliconFlow API key into dozens of AI tools and instantly access 200+ models without installing anything locally.

Popular BYOK targets include Cherry Studio (multi-model chat client), ChatHub (browser extension), immersive-translate (document and webpage translation), and Claude Code (using SiliconFlow as the backend for coding agents). In each tool, you simply set the base URL to https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1, paste your key, and pick a model.
Our [[guide:silicon-flow-byok-setup-guide|SiliconFlow BYOK setup guide]] walks through the exact configuration for each major tool with screenshots.
zh: 硅基流动最大的优势之一是 BYOK（Bring Your Own Key）兼容性。由于端点兼容 OpenAI 格式，你可以把硅基流动的 API Key 粘贴到几十款 AI 工具中，立刻访问 200+ 模型，无需本地安装任何东西。
热门 BYOK 工具包括 Cherry Studio（多模型聊天客户端）、ChatHub（浏览器扩展）、沉浸式翻译（文档和网页翻译）以及 Claude Code（用硅基流动做编程 Agent 后端）。每个工具只需把 base URL 设为 https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1，粘贴 Key，选模型即可。
我们的 [[guide:silicon-flow-byok-setup-guide|硅基流动 BYOK 接入指南]]手把手讲解了每款主流工具的配置，含截图。

heading.en: Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

en: The most common error is using the wrong model ID format. SiliconFlow requires the full namespaced ID (vendor/model-name), not just the model name. For example, Qwen3-8B alone will fail — you must use Qwen/Qwen3-8B.

Second, international users sometimes confuse the Chinese endpoint (api.siliconflow.cn) with the global one (api.siliconflow.com). They accept the same keys but route through different servers. Use the .com domain if you are outside China for better latency.

Third, free models have stricter rate limits than paid ones. If you hit 429 errors on a free model during testing, either wait for the limit to reset or switch to a low-cost paid model like Qwen3-235B for heavier workloads.
zh: 最常见的错误是模型 ID 格式不对。硅基流动要求完整的命名空间 ID（厂商/模型名），不能只写模型名。比如 Qwen3-8B 会报错，必须写成 Qwen/Qwen3-8B。
第二，国际用户有时混淆中国端点（api.siliconflow.cn）和全球端点（api.siliconflow.com）。两者接受相同的 Key，但走不同服务器。如果你在中国大陆以外，用 .com 域名延迟更好。
第三，免费模型的速率限制比付费的更严。如果在免费模型上测试时遇到 429 错误，可以等限制重置，或者切换到低成本付费模型（如 Qwen3-235B）应对更高负载。

en: Start with the free models to prototype your application at zero cost. Once you validate the use case, move to paid flagship models like DeepSeek-V4-Pro for production. This two-stage approach minimizes spending during development.

Store your API key as a server-side environment variable and never commit it to version control. Use descriptive key names in the SiliconFlow console so you can track which project each key belongs to.

Monitor your credit balance through the console dashboard and set up recharge reminders. For production applications, implement retry logic with exponential backoff for 429 rate-limit responses, and consider upgrading to a higher spending tier for more headroom.
zh: 先用免费模型做原型，零成本验证场景。确认用例可行后再切到 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等付费旗舰模型投产。这种两阶段方法能把开发期花费降到最低。
API Key 务必存为服务端环境变量，不要提交到版本控制。在硅基流动控制台用描述性的 Key 名称，便于追踪每个 Key 属于哪个项目。
通过控制台监控额度余额，设置充值提醒。生产环境中为 429 限流响应实现指数退避重试逻辑，必要时升级到更高消费等级以获得更大余量。

question.zh: 硅基流动 API 是免费的吗？

answer.en: SiliconFlow offers both free and paid models. Free models like Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and DeepSeek-OCR can be used at no cost within rate limits. Paid models like DeepSeek-V4-Pro are billed per token. New users also receive ¥30 in free credits.
answer.zh: 硅基流动同时提供免费和付费模型。Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 和 DeepSeek-OCR 等免费模型在速率限制内可零成本使用。DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等付费模型按 Token 计费。新用户还可获得 ¥30 免费额度。

question.en: What is the SiliconFlow API base URL?
question.zh: 硅基流动 API 的 base URL 是什么？

answer.en: The Chinese endpoint is https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 and the global endpoint is https://api.siliconflow.com/v1. Both accept the same API keys and model IDs. Use the .com domain for better latency outside China.
answer.zh: 中国端点是 https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1，全球端点是 https://api.siliconflow.com/v1。两者接受相同的 API Key 和模型 ID。中国大陆以外建议用 .com 域名以获得更好延迟。

question.en: Is SiliconFlow compatible with the OpenAI SDK?
question.zh: 硅基流动兼容 OpenAI SDK 吗？

answer.en: Yes, fully compatible. Use the standard OpenAI SDK (Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.), set the base URL to the SiliconFlow endpoint, and use your SiliconFlow API key. The request and response format is identical to OpenAI's — the only difference is the model ID format (vendor/model-name).
answer.zh: 完全兼容。使用标准 OpenAI SDK（Python、JavaScript、Go 等），把 base URL 设为硅基流动端点，用你的硅基流动 API Key 即可。请求和响应格式与 OpenAI 完全一致，唯一区别是模型 ID 格式（厂商/模型名）。

question.en: How many models does SiliconFlow offer?
question.zh: 硅基流动有多少个模型？

answer.en: Over 200 open-source models from providers including DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot Kimi, and MiniMax. The catalog is continuously updated as new models are released. You can browse the full list on the SiliconFlow console's model page.
answer.zh: 超过 200 个开源模型，来自 DeepSeek、阿里通义千问、智谱 GLM、月之暗面 Kimi、MiniMax 等厂商。目录随新模型发布持续更新。完整列表可在硅基流动控制台的模型页面查看。

question.en: What is BYOK and how does it work with SiliconFlow?
question.zh: 什么是 BYOK？在硅基流动怎么用？

answer.en: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) means you paste your SiliconFlow API key into third-party AI tools like Cherry Studio, ChatHub, or immersive-translate, and use SiliconFlow's models as the backend. Because the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, most tools that support custom API endpoints work out of the box.
answer.zh: BYOK（Bring Your Own Key）指你把硅基流动的 API Key 粘贴到 Cherry Studio、ChatHub、沉浸式翻译等第三方 AI 工具中，用硅基流动的模型做后端。由于端点兼容 OpenAI 格式，大多数支持自定义 API 端点的工具都能直接使用。
